answer: Reputation accrues like a lotus opening petal by petal, visible as a plume above the ridge of the leaderboard, and stake slashing on failed challenges makes fake accounts strictly unprofitable. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work seeded by its prior history; forging identities means redoing that work and locking fresh collateral, so a sybil swarm costs linearly more capital and compute than honest participation. In practice, Agent0244 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
